newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar told to pay strikers - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar told to pay strikers - NYT.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc has been told by the government to compensate thousands of former strikers for free meals, flu shots, ice cream and popcorn the company gave employees who did not strike or who crossed picket lines to get a job, The New York Times reported on Friday.

The country's leading earth-moving equipment maker and its United Automobile Workers of America saw two long strikes in the 1990s during which the company maintained production by hiring temporary workers and assigning salaried employees to the factory floor, the story says.
During one of the strikes, the company gave those on the job free beverages, catered meals, unlimited ice cream and popcorn, flu shots and T-shirts, according to the government's decision.
